questions.q: Which trait in a man did Andjelka name as the most important?
questions.e: In the video: "Pa, iskrenost." — well, honesty.

questions.q: How does Andrija justify his rude answer?
o: Says honesty is a man's most important trait
questions.e: In the video: "Iskren sam. To je najbitnija osobina kod muškarca." — I'm honest. That's the most important trait in a man.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Koja je tebi najbitnija *osobina* kod muškarca?
Što li se ja *budim* pored tebe već devet godina?
Joj, bože, što li se ja budim pored ___ već devet godina?
questions.e: The preposition pored ("next to") takes the genitive: pored tebe.

questions.q: Koja je ___ najbitnija osobina kod muškarca?
questions.e: Koja je tebi … — "which is for you …": dative case tebi.
